system.description: Usually a prerequisite when building a temple, this rite acts as the single-item Consecration above, but is applied to an area equal to the theurge’s Extrovert rating ×10 in square meters. Consecrated ground is impassable to the walking dead, and occult powers originating from unpenitent psychics, Antinomists or negative Ur-artifacts receive a penalty equal to the victory points from casting the Consecration.
